summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new 'Let's Connect' contact system. Backend APIs (52/54 passing, 96.3%). Frontend features mostly functional with 3 critical bugs found: (1) Discard confirmation dialog buttons not clickable due to overlay interception, (2) Conditional form fields not appearing when selecting different reasons, (3) Submit button remains disabled even after checking consent. All responsive dialog variants working correctly (drawer, modal, bottom sheet, full-screen). Button visibility rules, privacy page, admin settings section, and regression checks all passing.

minor_issues.issue: Rate limiting triggers at 5th request instead of 6th request
minor_issues.impact: Rate limiting is functional but off-by-one - not critical as spam protection is working

critical_bugs.issue: Discard confirmation dialog buttons ('Keep Editing', 'Discard') are not clickable - overlay intercepts pointer events
critical_bugs.reproduction: 1. Open floating dialog, 2. Fill name field, 3. Press Escape, 4. Try to click 'Keep Editing' or 'Discard' - clicks are blocked by overlay
critical_bugs.suggested_fix: Add z-index or pointer-events handling to AlertDialog buttons, or use force=true for Radix Dialog overlay

critical_bugs.issue: Conditional form fields do not appear when selecting different reasons from dropdown
critical_bugs.reproduction: 1. Open dialog, 2. Select 'I have a project for you' from reason dropdown - project_type and project_stage fields should appear but don't, 3. Select 'Let me pick your brain' - pick_brain_topic field should appear but doesn't

critical_bugs.issue: Submit button remains disabled even after all required fields are filled and consent checkbox is checked
critical_bugs.reproduction: 1. Open dialog, 2. Fill name, email, reason, message, 3. Check consent checkbox - submit button should enable but remains disabled
critical_bugs.note: This blocks all form submissions from the floating dialog

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix 3 CRITICAL frontend bugs: (1) Discard confirmation dialog buttons not clickable due to overlay z-index issue - add pointer-events handling or higher z-index to AlertDialog buttons, (2) Conditional form fields not appearing when reason is selected - check ConnectForm.js conditional rendering logic and state updates, (3) Submit button remains disabled after consent is checked - debug isValid calculation in ConnectForm.js. Backend rate limiting off-by-one is minor and non-blocking. After fixes, re-test form submission flow end-to-end.
